entities.summary: Asilkan Nadir was a British Turkish Cypriot businessman. He was the chief executive of Polly Peck, which he took over as a small textile company. During the 1980s, he expanded it into one of the United Kingdom's top 100 FTSE-listed companies, with interests in consumer electronics, fruit distribution, and packaging.
